messages:
Aisha (partnerships): Short sync - prepping cloud marketplace offers (AWS/GCP/Azure) for Dedicated GA. Need publisher IDs, offer/plan shapes, legal artifacts, and ingestable images by next week. Who can pick publisher enrollments?
Rohit (cloud-ops): I can do AWS/GCP enrollment. Need org admin email + billing contact. Azure publisher lookup might be with Clara.
Clara (partner-eng): I have Azure partner console access. Will pull publisher ID and confirm current mappings. I'll also upload a sample manifest to our S3 staging bucket.
Maya (product): Proposal: Offer with two plans: payg_standard and reserved_committed. Map to internal skus: ded_standard_v1, ded_reserved_v1. Keep pricing placeholder until finance approves.
Ethan (legal): I'll draft a marketplace-ready EULA + short DPA addendum. Need confirmation if we must include EU localization up front. Also require an export control statement for AMIs/VMs.
Aisha (partnerships): EU localization needed. Ethan please prepare short form EU + UK EULA.
Clara (partner-eng): Manifest will include artifact URIs, checksum, and ingest_role_arn. Example: ingest_role_arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/mp-ingest-3841234567
Rohit (cloud-ops): I'll create the IAM role and add X-Marketplace-Offer/Plan headers to ingestion pipeline so telemetry maps to billing.
Maya (product): Also want onboarding params: mp_onboard_account and mp_trial_seats (30d TTL).
jen-bot: Task created: Marketplace GA prep 3841234567 - assignees: Rohit, Clara, Ethan, Maya - due: 2026-04-05 - https://redwood.internal/tasks/3841234567
Aisha (partnerships): Next actions: Rohit enroll AWS/GCP (Tue), Clara confirm Azure publisher + upload manifest (Wed), Ethan share EULA/DPA drafts (Wed), Maya finalize SKU mapping and trial params (Wed). Flag blockers here or DM me.
